title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Mine Peza.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Mine Peza, very close to the center of Tirana! The apartment has a total area = 53 m2, while the net area = 46 m2. It is located on the 3rd floor of a building built in 2005, without an elevator. (It was agreed to be decided soon.)
